findings.title: Entity IDs not sorted alphabetically in async_setup_entry
findings.claim: Sensor entities are initialized in non-alphabetical order in async_setup_entry, violating the D8 brief requirement to sort every entity_id.
findings.mechanism: Entities appended to list in definition order rather than alphabetical by translation_key.

findings.title: DHW temperature disabled by default but used in card
findings.claim: The dhw_temperature entity is disabled by default but is referenced in the card, causing fresh installs to lack this entity when card attempts to display it.
findings.mechanism: DHWTemperatureSensor has _attr_entity_registry_enabled_default = False, but card.mjs contains patterns matching dhw_temperature.
